Watch AI chess unfold as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 face off in two intense matches. See how these models handle complex strategy.

This video explores the performance limits of modern language models in a competitive environment. We run two distinct games between GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 to test their strategic reasoning, move calculation, and ability to maintain a winning position. Despite one model holding a material advantage, neither engine managed to secure a definitive victory, resulting in stalemate scenarios that highlight the current ceiling of LLM performance benchmark.
